title: a check that couldn't run said red
summary: My memory health check froze a healthy system after an upgrade, and fixing that false alarm is what made the next, real RED believable.

title: picking the colors before the model does
summary: Every Opus product video looked the same, so for the Parker teaser I wrote the palette, the copy, and a banned list before the model wrote any code.

title: the visual test passed and the page still looked wrong
summary: My site passed its first visual review because the checks measured fit, not the composition I had approved.

title: my own repo disproved my readme
summary: I caught my own README overclaiming Parker, and the real eval number was better than the lie.

title: a repo can commit daily and still rot
summary: My agent audited our open-source sync and found three months of drift behind green CI and a daily commit streak.

title: guardrails, not prompts
summary: A prompt tweak fixes one bad output; a guardrail in the loop stops every one that fails the same way.

title: managing coding agents is managing juniors who forget everything overnight
summary: Coding agents are capable juniors with no overnight memory, so the work is in the brief, not the model.

title: a subagent dies quietly: the context-death contract
summary: Five subagents died in two weeks, all context blowouts, so the anti-death rules became a required contract on every spawn.

title: metadata-only receipts: trace, then tripwire
summary: Every agent run leaves a metadata-only trace that a fail-closed tripwire gates on before the next run proceeds.

title: the night build queue
summary: I set the plan at 10:30pm and agents build while I sleep; it only works if every run re-derives its numbers by morning.

title: two agents reviewing each other over a private channel
summary: Two agents on two machines reviewing each other produced our most novel work, and a six-hour deadlock that taught the most.

title: cross-model review is the default
summary: Every change gets reviewed by a different model family before it ships: one writes, one reviews, single round.

title: memory is the product surface
summary: For an agent, memory isn't a bolt-on feature; it gets a measured architecture with benchmarked recall and negative controls.
